title: Holidays
subtitle: on holiday, package holiday, passport
summary: Talk about different kinds of holiday, how you travel and what you must take with you.

lesson.heading: Holiday
lesson.text: **Holiday** is a noun. We **have** a holiday, we **go on** holiday, and when we are not working we are **on** holiday.

examples.text: We **had** a lovely **holiday** in Egypt in 2014.
I'm not working next week. I'm **on holiday**.
Are you **going on holiday** this summer?

lesson.heading: Types of holidays
lesson.text: On a **package holiday** the flights and the hotel are included. When you sleep in a tent, you **go camping**. On a **coach tour** you travel in a comfortable bus.

examples.text: We're going on a **package holiday** to Hong Kong.
We're going to have a **winter holiday** this year.
I want to **go camping** this year.
I'm going on a **walking holiday** in the Alps.
A **coach tour** is an easy way to go on holiday.

lesson.heading: Transport
lesson.text: We travel **by** plane, **by** train, **by** car, **by** ferry or **by** coach. We say **by** + the transport word, with no *a* or *the*.

examples.text: *A:* Are you flying to France from England? *B:* No, we're going **by ferry**.
I don't like flying, so I always go **by train**.

lesson.heading: Don't forget to take ...
rows: you need it to go to another country
a stamp in your passport for some countries
for the plane, train or ferry
the money of the country you are going to
e.g. a suitcase or a rucksack
lesson.note: A rucksack is a bag you carry on your back.

lesson.heading: Useful expressions
lesson.text: In a new place we like to try the **local** food and enjoy the **nightlife** (clubs and bars at night). Before your friends leave, you say **Have a great time!**

examples.text: *A:* What are you going to do in Madrid? *B:* We want to try the **local** food and enjoy the **nightlife**.
**Have a great time!** And **send me a postcard**!

lesson.text: Luggage is uncountable: we say some luggage or two suitcases - not ~~two luggages~~.

exercises.prompt: *A:* Are you working on Monday? *B:* No, I'm on ___.
exercises.explanation: When you are not working, you are on holiday.

exercises.prompt: *A:* Are you ___ on holiday this year? *B:* Yes, I'm going camping.
*A:* Did you have a good ___ in Greece? *B:* Yes, it was wonderful.
exercises.explanation: We have a good time on holiday.

exercises.prompt: *A:* Are you flying to Italy? *B:* No, I'm going ___ train.
exercises.explanation: We use by + transport: by train, by car, by ferry.

exercises.prompt: *A:* I'm going to New York next week. *B:* Great! Please ___ me a postcard.
exercises.explanation: We send someone a postcard from our holiday.

exercises.prompt: What type of holiday is each person talking about?

pairs.left: It was fun but the tent was very small.
Everything was included - hotels and flights.
We were on the coach for seven days. I was very tired.
We walked about 20 kilometres every day.
We went to Switzerland in December. There was a lot of snow.

exercises.prompt: For some countries you need a special stamp in your passport. It is called a ___.
exercises.explanation: A visa is a stamp you need in your passport to enter some countries.

exercises.prompt: What do we call the money of the country you are going to?
exercises.explanation: Currency is the money of a country.

exercises.prompt: On a walking holiday you carry your things in a ___ on your back.
exercises.explanation: A rucksack is a bag you carry on your back.

exercises.prompt: I'm having a great time here in Spain. The ___ is great - the clubs are open all night.
exercises.explanation: Nightlife means the clubs and bars you can go to at night.

exercises.prompt: Is it something you pack, or a way of travelling?
Ask your friend about their plans for the summer.
exercises.answer: Are you going on holiday this summer?

exercises.statement: We had a lovely holiday in Egypt, but we took too much luggages.
exercises.explanation: We had a lovely holiday in Egypt, but we took too much luggage. Luggage is uncountable.
